我现在需要回答用户的问题：“Deutsche 話 Microsoft F2Q 嘅 Azure 增長有幾多？同 guidance 比點？”首先，我需要确定用户的问题是关于微软2026财年第二季度（F2Q）的Azure增长率，以及该增长率与德意志银行给出的指导意见之间的比较。

接下来，我需要检查提供的知识库条目，找到相关的信息。首先看第一个知识库条目，来自德意志银行的报告，日期是2026年1月29日。其中提到：“Azure growth of +38% y/y @CC was 1pt above guidance (37%), but likely a touch shy of buyside expectations that we believe were closer to ~+39%.” 这里明确指出Azure在不变汇率下的同比增长率为38%，比指导的37%高出1个百分点，但略低于市场预期的39%。

然后，第二个知识库条目也是德意志银行的报告，提到：“Azure growth of +38% y/y @CC was 1pt above guidance (37%), but likely a touch shy of what we believe was a buyside bogey of >39%+ and what mgmt. indicated would have been >40% had they allocated all incremental GPU capacity in F1H26 to Azure.” 这里进一步确认了Azure的增长率为38%，高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的39%以上。

第三个知识库条目同样来自德意志银行，提到：“F3Q Azure guidance of +37-38% y/y @CC was 1.5-2.5pt ahead of consensus ~35.5%, signaling stability despite a 4pt harder comp. and expectations for demand to remain significantly ahead of available capacity.” 这里虽然是关于第三季度的指导，但也提到Azure的增长率在37-38%之间，高于市场预期。

第四个知识库条目是中国 Renaissance 证券的报告，提到：“Azure delivered 39% (38% in forex neutral) YoY growth in the quarter, slightly above the 37% guidance but below Visible Alpha’s consensus of 40%.” 这里指出Azure的增长率为39%（不变汇率下38%），高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的40%。

综合这些信息，不同的报告中Azure的增长率略有不同，但总体上都显示38%的增长率高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的39%左右。需要注意的是，不同报告中的市场预期可能略有差异，但核心结论一致。

此外，还需要确认是否有其他相关信息，比如是否有关于指导的具体说明，或者增长率的计算方式。例如，第一个报告中提到“guidance (37%)”，而第三个报告中提到“F3Q Azure guidance of +37-38% y/y @CC”，这可能是指不同季度的指导。用户的问题是关于F2Q，所以需要关注F2Q的指导。

总结来说，Deutsche Bank的报告指出F2Q Azure增长率为38%，高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的39%。其他报告也支持这一结论，尽管市场预期略有不同。因此，回答时需要明确这一点，并引用具体的知识库条目作为来源。
### Microsoft F2Q Azure 增长及与指引对比分析  
根据德意志银行（Deutsche Bank）的报告，Microsoft 2026财年第二季度（F2Q）Azure 收入同比增长率为 **38%（不变汇率，@CC）**，**高于管理层指引的37%**，但 **略低于市场预期（约39%）**。  

#### 关键细节：  
1. **增长表现**：  
   - Azure 增长38%（@CC），超出指引1个百分点，主要受益于效率提升释放部分容量至可盈利的 Azure 需求。  
   - 若管理层在F1H26将所有增量GPU容量分配给Azure，增长率可能超过40%，但受限于AI应用（如M365 Copilot、GitHub Copilot）和研发投入的GPU需求，实际增速受限。  

2. **市场预期**：  
   - 市场普遍预期Azure增长约39%，实际增速低于预期，反映GPU供应约束对扩张的影响。  

3. **后续指引**：  
   - 管理层指引F3Q Azure增长为 **37-38%（@CC）**，仍高于市场预期（约35.5%），显示Azure需求持续强劲，但供应约束仍将持续。

29 January 2026
Microsoft reported another solid result for F2Q, but it ultimately fell short of more 
lofty market expectations, in particular for Azure growth. While most investors 
continue to hone in on this as the most important KPI, mgmt. again made it clear 
Azure is bearing the brunt of current supply constraints as they prioritize GPU 
allocation in support of AI usage in first-party apps and R&D to accelerate product 
innovation in pursuit of higher margin, recurring software opportunities up the 
stack. So while Azure growth still came in 1pt above guidance at +38% y/y @CC, 
this was shy of what we believe was a buyside bogey of >39%+ and what mgmt. 
indicated would have been >40% had they allocated all incremental GPU capacity 
in F1H26 to Azure. Importantly, we'd highlight Azure is still growing well above the 
market, guided to sustain 37-38% growth in F3Q and we believe can likely persist 
near here for several more quarters off a higher base.
From a margin and LTV perspective we believe the application layer has and is still 
generally perceived as highly strategic ground on which Microsoft has incumbent 
advantages. But we'd argue it is also the last area to see tangible benefits as AI 
monetization works its way up the stack, and is more than ever viewed as at risk of 
disruption and/or devaluation, which is weighing on sentiment. That story has yet 
to play out in our view, so while foregoing Azure revenue now for high-margin 
application and consumer SW opportunity ahead seems a sensible long-term 
strategy, it puts the onus on Microsoft to deliver before it will get credit. We continue 
to see more evidence of steadily growing traction, including new disclosure this 
quarter of 15m paid M365 Copilot seats (accelerating q/q and +160% y/y), paid 
GitHub Copilot subs now up to 4.7m (+75% y/y) and >100k medical providers using 
Dragon Copilot, but likely not yet tangible enough in financial results for investors 
to feel like they are seeing high impact from an ROIC perspective.
Bringing it back to a high level perspective, we think some of the debate and nuance 
around near-term bogeys, while important, is missing a story of exceptional share 
gains and execution. Amidst a heavy investment cycle and supply constraints, the 
company is poised to deliver a third straight year of mid-teens+ growth in operating 
income (incl. y/y margin expansion) and non-GAAP EPS. With continued strong 
demand signal from backlog (Commercial RPO +28% y/y ex-OAI) we remain 
confident in the durability of top- and bottom-line trajectories over the next several 
years. We maintain our Buy rating while adjusting our target price to $575 (from 
$630) to reflect our updated estimates and thoughts on the business and market. 
Our TP implies ~28x our updated CY27E non-GAAP EPS.

short-lived assets expected to be similar to F2Q. Separately, mgmt. noted rising 
memory prices could impact capital expenditures for the full year; however impact 
to Microsoft Cloud gross margins will be phased given the 6-year depreciation life 
of these assets.

F2Q26 Review: Progresses in Azure and beyond Azure
•
F2Q26 results largely in line; Azure growth affected by supply constraints.
•
Company achieved solid performance beyond Azure supported by its AI 
investments. 
•
Reiterate BUY and TP of US$630.00 (34x FY27E P/E).
Azure and capital investments: Azure delivered 39% (38% in forex neutral) YoY growth 
in the quarter, slightly above the 37% guidance but below Visible Alpha’s consensus of 
40%. Management guided 37-38% YoY growth for the next quarter, also below 39% 
consensus. Capex of the quarter was US$37.5bn (vs.US$34.9bn last quarter), of which 
2/3 was for CPUs and GPUs (increased from ~50% mix last quarter yet is expected to 
remain at this level for next quarter, per mgmt), and the remaining 1/3 of spending is for 
long-term assets such as datacenters. The company added about 1 gigawatt of total 
capacity this quarter but still faces supply constraints as demand remains strong. 
It’s not just Azure. As management highlighted on the call, its capex spending is for 
multiple purposes: 1) first-party AI usage services such as M365 Copilot and GitHub 
Copilot, 2) internal R&D teams, and 3) Azure business. In the continuing situation of supply 
constraints, Azure cannot fully expand its business to serve all the potential demand on 
the market, which would have helped it deliver over 40% growth for the quarter. 
Management also disclosed incremental achievements in other businesses supported by 
its AI investments. For example, its paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats reached 15mn in the 
quarter, and the number of business customers with over 35k seats tripled YoY. By nature, 
SaaS projects/subscriptions usually have higher margin than pure cloud rental business. 
F2Q26 financial highlights: Total revenue growth was 17% YoY, 1% higher than FactSet 
consensus. Total commercial Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO) was US$625bn 
by quarter end, +230% YoY, with weighted avg duration of 2.5 years. Within that, about 
45% is from the recent multi-year Azure services commitment from OpenAI. The remaining 
55% is from a broad-based customer base and represents a healthy 28% YoY growth. 
Operating margin was 47.1% for the quarter, vs 45.5% in F2Q25. Management anticipates 
FY26 full-year operating margin to be slightly up YoY, which would mark FY26 as the third 
year of margin expansion despite AI investments. 
Financial revisions: We keep our FY26E/ 27E revenue and operating income forecasts 
largely unchanged. FY26 GAAP net income/ EPS now includes a US$4.5bn/ US$0.61 
impact from its OpenAI investment net gain in other income in F1H26. Our FY26E capex 
forecast remains at ~US$150bn.
Reiterate BUY and TP of US$630.00, based on 34x FY27E P/E (prior: 40x FY26E) to 
reflect strong Azure momentum. Risks include: slower AI adoption, lagging 
innovation/competition in AI, weak macro picture, regulatory hurdles, and higher-than-
expected operating expenditure.

我现在需要回答用户的问题：“Deutsche 話 Microsoft F2Q 嘅 Azure 增長有幾多？同 guidance 比點？”首先，我需要确定用户的问题是关于微软2026财年第二季度（F2Q）的Azure增长率，以及该增长率与德意志银行给出的指导意见之间的比较。

接下来，我需要检查提供的知识库条目，找到相关的信息。首先看第一个知识库条目，来自德意志银行的报告，日期是2026年1月29日。其中提到：“Azure growth of +38% y/y @CC was 1pt above guidance (37%), but likely a touch shy of buyside expectations that we believe were closer to ~+39%.” 这里明确指出Azure在不变汇率下的同比增长率为38%，比指导的37%高出1个百分点，但略低于市场预期的39%。

然后，第二个知识库条目也是德意志银行的报告，提到：“Azure growth of +38% y/y @CC was 1pt above guidance (37%), but likely a touch shy of what we believe was a buyside bogey of >39%+ and what mgmt. indicated would have been >40% had they allocated all incremental GPU capacity in F1H26 to Azure.” 这里进一步确认了Azure的增长率为38%，高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的39%以上。

第三个知识库条目同样来自德意志银行，提到：“F3Q Azure guidance of +37-38% y/y @CC was 1.5-2.5pt ahead of consensus ~35.5%, signaling stability despite a 4pt harder comp. and expectations for demand to remain significantly ahead of available capacity.” 这里虽然是关于第三季度的指导，但也提到Azure的增长率在37-38%之间，高于市场预期。

第四个知识库条目是中国 Renaissance 证券的报告，提到：“Azure delivered 39% (38% in forex neutral) YoY growth in the quarter, slightly above the 37% guidance but below Visible Alpha’s consensus of 40%.” 这里指出Azure的增长率为39%（不变汇率下38%），高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的40%。

综合这些信息，不同的报告中Azure的增长率略有不同，但总体上都显示38%的增长率高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的39%左右。需要注意的是，不同报告中的市场预期可能略有差异，但核心结论一致。

此外，还需要确认是否有其他相关信息，比如是否有关于指导的具体说明，或者增长率的计算方式。例如，第一个报告中提到“guidance (37%)”，而第三个报告中提到“F3Q Azure guidance of +37-38% y/y @CC”，这可能是指不同季度的指导。用户的问题是关于F2Q，所以需要关注F2Q的指导。

总结来说，Deutsche Bank的报告指出F2Q Azure增长率为38%，高于指导的37%，但低于市场预期的39%。其他报告也支持这一结论，尽管市场预期略有不同。因此，回答时需要明确这一点，并引用具体的知识库条目作为来源。

### Microsoft F2Q Azure 增长及与指引对比分析  
根据德意志银行（Deutsche Bank）的报告，Microsoft 2026财年第二季度（F2Q）Azure 收入同比增长率为 **38%（不变汇率，@CC）**，**高于管理层指引的37%**，但 **略低于市场预期（约39%）**。  

#### 关键细节：  
1. **增长表现**：  
   - Azure 增长38%（@CC），超出指引1个百分点，主要受益于效率提升释放部分容量至可盈利的 Azure 需求。  
   - 若管理层在F1H26将所有增量GPU容量分配给Azure，增长率可能超过40%，但受限于AI应用（如M365 Copilot、GitHub Copilot）和研发投入的GPU需求，实际增速受限。  

2. **市场预期**：  
   - 市场普遍预期Azure增长约39%，实际增速低于预期，反映GPU供应约束对扩张的影响。  

3. **后续指引**：  
   - 管理层指引F3Q Azure增长为 **37-38%（@CC）**，仍高于市场预期（约35.5%），显示Azure需求持续强劲，但供应约束仍将持续。
